label: Every SERIES_OF_CAUSES_4 link is PER_SE_5, from e8664ab8 and the sense inclusion
description: Conditional derivation recording the strength order between the two bridges: if every SERIES_OF_CAUSES_3 link is a PER_SE_5 actual cause of being (e8664ab8) and every SERIES_OF_CAUSES_4 link is a SERIES_OF_CAUSES_3 link, then every SERIES_OF_CAUSES_4 link is a PER_SE_5 actual cause of being. So, given the sense bridge, the restated bridge is weaker than e8664ab8; it is the version that survives the hand-and-stick counterexample kept against e8664ab8. This is a support option for the restated bridge through a premise with a kept counterexample; the restated bridge's other support option (from 8b2561cd and the present-cause bridge) does not use e8664ab8. oldBridgeControls give, for each input, a Bool interpretation in which the other holds and the conclusion fails, and a nonvacuous one. secundaSplitLimit (attached here because this Solution's export uses no Subrelation; see the attempt on the export defect) is a Nat interpretation with two respects, being and motion: actual grounding, the weak esse-ground bridge, both actuality calibrations, fd12ad3d, ea251340, the restated bridge, the sense inclusion and the existential no-regress premise hold with the existential link 1 -> 0; efficient causing in the motion respect is the upward successor, the secunda via's per se ordering premise 8a22ae75 and c2880fe0 hold; yet 97f5850f and the per se mover regress fail and e8664ab8 fails. So, under the encoded predicates, the existential order does not entail 97f5850f, the mover regress or e8664ab8. Facts about that interpretation only.
